name: Language
overview: Scripture reveals that originally the whole earth shared one language and speech, as seen in Genesis 11:1, but after the events at the plain of Shinar, languages diversified among nations and families (Genesis 10:5, 10:20, 10:31; 11:2-3). This division of tongues underscores God's sovereign design in the formation of distinct peoples and cultures, highlighting both the unity and diversity of human communication as established from the earliest biblical accounts.
